Azerbaijan Faces Protests Over School Hijab Restrictions

Protests have erupted in Azerbaijan following new restrictions on wearing the hijab in schools. The controversy stems from changes to school uniform policies, leading to intense debate over religious freedoms and educational regulations. Reports indicate students and teachers are reacting to these measures, with some protests resulting in arrests.
